svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given the guide at #howitworks; beat 1: you open it → two acts tell the same three moments — assigning work, reviewing it, two weeks later — first without the tool ("Done, boss!", a wall of code, the same bug back) then with it, every step a drawn scene; beat 2: you click → the walkthrough steps forward one scene and holds — it never advances on its own

g.text: The task lives in a chat scroll and then scrolls
A requirement is a title that expands; a test is
A beat row is a comparison: same region, same be
the same hire, plus a system that makes work rev
Search across requirement text, grouped into are
The proof is scannable as frames, not only as vi
A conflict is one fact stated two incompatible w
a brilliant, fast hire whose work you cannot rev
none right now — nothing has drifted
none right now — everything is covered
One card per screen, not a row of cells
Home leads with what the board does
